---
title: "`iiif-cite`"
---


A single-page web app to make IIIF browsing citable.

Demos:

- [*Io. Friderici Weidleri Historia Astronomiae*](./iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://manifests.sub.uni-goettingen.de/iiif/presentation/PPN623133725/manifest) (manifest from [Universität Göttingen](https://manifests.sub.uni-goettingen.de/iiif/presentation/PPN623133725/manifest))
- [Venetus A manuscript](./iiif-cite.html#manifest=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/homermultitext/hmt-archive/refs/heads/master/iiif/venetusA.json) (manifest from [Homer Multitext project](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/homermultitext/hmt-archive/refs/heads/master/iiif/venetusA.json))
